verses.text: Ha heb' kajan t'a Zif ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa icha tik: Ha winhaj David ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a jolom witz yik Haquila, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Jesimón, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl yet' oxe' mil heb' soldado yik Israel te jelan. Ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi', yik sayek' winhaj David chi' heb'.
Ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a tzalan Haquila chi' t'a ti b'e, haxo winhaj David chi' ayek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Ix yab'an winh to wan sayjiek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl ta'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at jaywanh yilumal winh yik sb'at yilan heb' tato yel to ayxo ek' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi yab'an winhaj David chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl chi' t'ak'walil, ix cham wal yilan winh b'aj sway winh yet' winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, haton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado. Haxo ix yilan winh to ha t'a snanhal yol campamento chi', hata' sway winh, oyanoch heb' soldado t'a spatiktak winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec hitita yet' t'a winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia icha tik: --¿Mach b'ekan sk'ol sb'at wet'ok b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl t'a yol scampamento chi'? xchi winh. --Ha in tik ol in b'at het'ok, xchi winhaj Abisai chi'.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winhaj David yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a campamento chi'. Ha winhaj Saúl chi' chamnak el winh swayi. Ha t'a sjolomtak winh, hata' tipankanem k'e'en slanza winh t'a yol lu'um. Haxo pax winhaj Abner yet' masanil heb' soldado, waynak heb' t'a stz'eytak winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai chi' t'a winhaj David chi': --Ha wal tikne'ik toxo ix yak'och jun winh ajk'o'ol tik Dios t'a yol a k'ab'. Ak' in permiso tzin milcham winh. Ha k'e'en slanza winh tik tzin tipem t'a sk'o'ol masanto tz'emk'och k'e'en t'a yol lu'um, junnhej swak' t'a winh, scham winh t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh: --Manh a milcham winh, yujto yalnhej mach smilancham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, yowalil sjawi yahelal t'a yib'anh.
Ha in tik swak' in ti' t'a Dios to aokab' ol ik'anel sk'inal winh ayik ol k'och stiempo'al scham winh, mato t'a skal owal ol cham winh.
Aokab' Jehová max cha'an in milcham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj. Anhej to tzik'kot k'e'en slanza winh ayek' t'a sjolomtak chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' chi', tzonh b'ati, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankot k'e'en lanza chi' winhaj David chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winhaj Saúl chi', ix kot heb' winh. Malaj mach ix hilani, malaj mach ix ab'ani, malaj mach ix el swayanh. Masanil heb' chamnak el swayi yujto a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan wayanh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj David chi' t'a junxo sk'axepal jun ch'olan, ix k'e winh t'a sjolom jun lum witz, najat ix aj skal heb'.

Te cha'anh ix awaj winh t'a winhaj Abner yet' t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Abner, tak'wan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Abner chi' icha tik: --¿Mach ach, yuj chi' tzach awaj t'a winh rey tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ab'i malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok t'a skal heb' ketisraelal tik jun. Tato icha chi', ¿tas yuj max a tanhwej winh rey kajalil chi'? Ay jun winh ix xit'ek' ta' ix snib'ej smilcham winh.

Ha tas ix a k'ulej chi' manh wach'ok. Ha in tik swal t'a yichanh Jehová to he moj wal tzex cham he masanil, yujto max he tanhwej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová. Say ila' b'ajtil ayek' k'e'en slanza winh yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winh, ol hilani tato ol chax u'uj, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an sjaj winhaj David chi' winhaj Saúl, ix awaj cha'anh winh: --Ach David, ¿tom a ach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --I', mamin, a in toni.
Palta mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzin a pechb'eyek'ok? ¿Tas chukal ix in k'ulej t'ayach? ¿Tas in mul ix och t'ayach?

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza cha ab' tas ol wala': Tato a Jehová ix ach ak'anoch ajk'olal t'ayin, komonok wal tz'el t'a sk'o'ol scha'an junok silab' yik tzin yak'an niwank'olal. Palta tato anima ay yik jun tik jun, aokab' Jehová skatab'ani. Yujto ix in spechel heb' t'a in makb'en t'a jun lum lum to yik Jehová yaji, icha wal to tzin spechkanb'at heb' yik swak'an serwil juntzanh komon Dios.

Komonok manh najatok ayin el t'a yichanh Jehová ayik tzin chami. Palta mamin rey, ¿tas yuj tzach elta ul in a sayek'i? Ha in tik malaj welk'och icha junok nok' k'ak. Tzin a pechan b'eyek' t'a jolomtak witz tik icha mach sayan junok nok' ub', palta malaj b'ak'inh syamchaj nok' yuj, xchi winh.

Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach David, swojtakejel tikne'ik ma to a in ix och in mul. Icha junok malaj spensar, icha chi' swutej in b'a, te chuk tzin k'ulej t'ayach. Yuj chi', meltzajanh. Manhxo ol wak'laj chukal t'ayach, yujto ha t'a jun k'u tik ix a ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol a sat, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj David chi': --Mamin rey, ina yajek' k'e'en a lanza t'a tik, kotokab' junok heb' winh a soldado chi' ul yik' k'e'en.

Ha Jehová tz'ak'an spak t'ayonh junjun onh hato syala' tato tojol skutej ko b'a icha t'a smojal. Wach'chom a tikne'ik, ix ach yak'och t'a yol in k'ab', palta malaj in gana ix wak'och in k'ab' t'ayach, yujto a Jehová ach sik'anoch reyal.
Icha ix aj tikne'ik, te niwan elk'och t'a yol in sat, ichaton wal chi' in gana to ay pax welk'och t'a yol sat Jehová. Aokab' Jehová chi' tzin kolanel t'a masanil yahelal sjawi t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ach David, yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh ma. Swojtakejeli to niwak yelk'och tas ol a k'ulej, wach'nhej ol ach ajelk'ochok, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalacio, haxo winhaj David chi' ix b'atxikan winh.
